covers.brief: A huge terrified stick-figure face fills the frame, eyes wide with horror as bright orange flames burst out from an ancient Roman stone toilet below, with a wooden sponge-stick lying nearby on the marble floor. High contrast, top third calm for title.

A shocked stick figure wearing a red scarf recoils in disgust while holding up a dripping sea sponge tied to a wooden stick, with an ancient crowded Roman communal latrine visible in the background. High contrast, top third clear.

A wide-eyed stick figure sitting uncomfortably on an ancient marble latrine bench tightly sandwiched between other Romans, pointing downward in shock at a giant sewer rat emerging from the toilet hole. High contrast, top third calm.

scenes.brief: A clean modern bathroom where the stick figure with a red scarf walks calmly toward a bright white ceramic toilet.
The stick figure hand turns a small metal lock on a modern wooden bathroom door, safely securing complete privacy.
A sudden jump into ancient Rome where the red-scarf stick figure stands stunned amidst huge classical marble arches and bustling streets.
A long ancient Roman stone bench viewed from above, showing several round holes carved into the slab with running water underneath.
The red-scarf stick figure sits uncomfortably squeezed between two Roman citizens wrapped in togas on the open marble bench.
A large public Roman latrine hall with twenty stick-figure citizens sitting shoulder to shoulder along stone walls without any dividers.
A wide panoramic view over ancient Rome showing the giant Colosseum and thousands of tiny stick figures crowding narrow stone avenues.
A clean cutaway illustration of a crowded Roman apartment insula building showing multiple cramped floors without any pipes or running water.
A Roman stick figure standing inside a dim room holding an empty terracotta chamber pot with an exhausted, frustrated expression.
A crowd of Roman stick citizens rushing down a paved stone street toward the grand entrance of a public bathhouse.
The grand stone portal of a Roman public latrine where several citizens in tunics enter beneath a carved stone archway.
Two Roman stick figures sitting side by side on marble toilet openings, casually chatting with friendly hand gestures.
A Roman stick figure sitting on the stone toilet opening while enthusiastically unrolling a parchment scroll to discuss current politics.
Two wealthy Roman stickmen shaking stick hands across the toilet bench to finalize a business deal while remaining seated.
The red-scarf stick figure looking downward with massive wide panic eyes and visible sweat drops forming on the round head.
A modern roll of soft toilet paper shown clearly with a bold red diagonal cancellation line crossed directly over it.
A stick hand reaching down to grasp the wooden handle of a Roman tersorium tool with a natural sea sponge attached.
A detailed illustration of the tersorium stick featuring rough fibrous sea sponge lashed securely to the carved wooden rod with cord.
The red-scarf stick figure pinching its nose with one hand and leaning backward in intense, unmistakable disgust.
A weathered wooden bucket sitting on the stone floor holding several dripping tersorium sticks immersed in murky liquid.
Water sloshing inside a wooden bucket with coarse sea salt crystals and vinegar droplets floating beside the submerged sponge.
A top-down bird eye view showing three different stick hands reaching at the same moment toward a single communal sponge bucket.
A dark sinister shadow creeping upward through the circular hole of an ancient stone toilet seat, signaling hidden underground peril.
A vertical cutaway view showing running sewage water flowing swiftly through a deep stone channel directly underneath the toilet holes.
The massive subterranean vaulted brick tunnel of the Cloaca Maxima carrying dark wastewater deep beneath ancient Rome.
A split comparison comparing a modern curved water-trap pipe that blocks gas on the left with an open ancient straight hole on the right.
A vicious stick-figure rat with sharp teeth and long whiskers poking its head boldly out of an open stone toilet hole.
A cutaway view showing green poisonous gas bubbles accumulating under high pressure in the enclosed underground masonry channel.
A sudden burst of bright yellow and orange fire exploding upward out of the circular opening of a stone toilet seat.
A terrified Roman stick figure jumping into the air in shock as tall flames leap out from the bench beneath his toga.
A group of Roman citizens backing away from the toilet bench with raised hands, staring nervously at the dark openings.
The red-scarf stick figure kneeling respectfully with clasped hands before a colorful fresco painted directly on the latrine wall.
A small stone altar with burning incense resting on the tiled floor immediately beside the marble latrine bench.
An ancient wall painting of the goddess Fortuna holding a cornucopia and wheel of fortune right above the toilet bench.
The red-scarf stick figure standing comfortably inside a quiet, pristine modern bathroom with bright white tiles and shiny chrome fixtures.
The happy red-scarf stick figure hugging a soft roll of clean toilet paper with a relieved smile behind a closed bathroom door.
